body.text: I have been about the colony this month and there is one thing I would put before you.
{param:town} is in a bad way. I would {param:suggestion}.
I am aware you have a great many things to weigh that I do not see from here. I mention it because somebody ought to, and there is nobody else who will.
I have said so before. I do not expect it to be acted on this time either.
